name: Standing calf raise
notes: Standing machine, smith machine, or bodyweight calf raise.

guide.setup: Place the balls of the feet on a stable step or platform with the heels free to move.
guide.execution: Lower the heels into a controlled stretch, then press through the balls of the feet to rise as high as possible.
guide.cues: Use a full range. Keep knees softly straight. Pause at the top and bottom.
guide.mistakes: Bouncing; bending the knees to cheat; rolling to the outer feet; using only half range.

images.caption: Top position with heels raised high and ankles controlled over the toes.
